lines: Waystone. Aye. The brass collar off it. That was me.
Barley gate lost its hinge in the first winter.
dorrin.relay.1.speaker: dorrin

lines: No iron to spare. That brass was just sitting there.
Stone's been dark since. I knew. Didn't say.
dorrin.relay.2.speaker: dorrin

lines: Barley farm, east. Pull the brass. I'll rope the gate.
dorrin.relay.3.speaker: dorrin

lines: Gate's on rope now. Holds fine. Should've done it then.
Bring me that ruin steel some day. I owe you work.
dorrin.done.1.speaker: dorrin
